mapper.select: SELECT l.event FROM pda_find_requests r JOIN pda_alert_logs l ON l.request_id=r.id WHERE r.device_id=#{deviceId} AND r.store_id=#{storeId} AND l.event IN ('RETRY','INVALID_TOKEN','NO_TOKEN','PUSH_FIND','PUSH_STOP') ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,requester_id,store_id,device_id,status,expires_at FROM pda_find_requests WHERE device_id=#{deviceId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND expires_at>now() ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT id,requester_id,store_id,device_id,status,expires_at FROM pda_find_requests WHERE id=#{id} AND store_id=#{storeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pda_find_requests SET status=#{status},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','SENT','RINGING')
UPDATE pda_find_requests SET status='SENT',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED'
